name: POLICY-VERSION survives a Deny that covers only part of the granted scope
note: Allow CreatePolicyVersion + SetDefaultPolicyVersion on policy/team-* with a same-policy Deny on policy/team-admin only. The other team-* policies stay rewritable, so the path survives (narrowed). Guards the T1-04 catalog-expansion and N2 containment changes against over-suppressing a partial-cover Deny.
